item.description: Vermont took its statewide police records system offline after a security alert. Emergency services and nine-one-onecalls continue without interruption. Agencies are using backup procedures while the system is investigated.
Sugarbush Resort's opening day has been postponed. Skiers and snowboarders will need to wait for a new date.

Vermont's latest education report shows slight gains in student proficiency. English language arts proficiency is fifty-six percent, math forty-two percent, and science forty-five percent. Achievement gaps persist for students with disabilities and economically disadvantaged students.

VNA & Hospice of the Southwest Region honored employees for outstanding service during VNA Week. Nurse Francetta Tice received Employee of the Year, and two rookies were also recognized. The agency serves Bennington, Rutland, and Franklin counties with home health and hospice care.
